task: closed-set poem-level attribution under synthetic text corruption; retrieval/OCR/ASR deferred

source.raw_redistribution: not cleared; keep source cache local

acquisition.cap_failure: stop and version the design before model fitting; never silently lower quality or target counts

eligibility.language_limit: script filter is not proof of Persian-only content
eligibility.text_source: Verses.Text sorted by VOrder once; no metadata or section-text concatenation

development_exclusion.policy: exclude every graph component touching an inspected audit poem from the final 1000

edges: at least 2 distinct identical normalized couplets, each at least 6 whitespace tokens
grouping.method: exact deterministic checks; safe size-bound pruning allowed; no unrecorded approximate-neighbour substitution
grouping.mixed_author_components: exclude entire component and record disputed/quoted linkage
grouping.representative: one poem per remaining single-author component, lowest selection-priority hash
grouping.selection_priority: SHA256 ASCII 'poetry-text-v1|20261023|PoetId|PoemId'; bytewise ascending digest, then numeric Id
grouping.author_selection: first 200 component representatives per author; all rejection reasons saved
grouping.limitation: heuristic graph does not prove no partial quotation or shared editorial provenance

split.unit: one poem representative per distinct retained component
split.priority: SHA256 ASCII 'split-v1|20261024|PoetId|PoemId'; ascending digest then Id; first 120 train, next 40 validation, final 40 test

preprocessing.minimal: join source verses with LF; normalize CRLF only; preserve marks, script variants, ZWNJ and punctuation
preprocessing.canonical: NFKC; map U+064A/U+0649 to U+06CC and U+0643 to U+06A9; strip U+064B..065F, U+0670, U+06D6..06ED and U+0640; ZWNJ to space; collapse whitespace; preserve punctuation
preprocessing.mask_matching: scan maximal Unicode-category L/M runs in source text; canonicalize each run for exact alias lookup; replace matching source spans once with shared ASCII token before either normalization
preprocessing.mask_limit: not all signatures; words may have ordinary meanings; positions/counts remain cues; same alias rule across classes; no label-specific replacement

features.fit: training only for vocabulary and IDF; validation/test transform only
features.capacity_limit: equal caps do not imply equal feature counts or model capacity

corruption.scope: primary pair plus majority only; synthetic stress after canonical normalization/masking, before vectorization
corruption.eligible: original character in the listed alphabet; shared ASCII mask token, whitespace and punctuation protected
corruption.seed: PCG64 default_rng(int.from_bytes(SHA256 ASCII 'noise-v1|Seed|PoemId' digest first 8 bytes,'big'))
corruption.selection: one permutation of eligible source positions per poem/seed; k=(integer_percent*N+50)//100 with integer_percent in [0,2,5,10]; first k positions gives nested severity
corruption.operations: one stable independent draw per source position, insertion/deletion/substitution each probability 1/3; insertion before original; inserted alphabet letter uniform; substitution uniform excluding original
corruption.pairing: identical generated query string for both primary feature models and majority; no noisy-data fitting
corruption.measured_error: CER=Levenshtein/clean codepoint count; WER=token Levenshtein/clean whitespace-token count; remove MASKEDAUTHOR from both strings before measuring; report actual edits and errors
corruption.limitation: nominal selected-letter rate is not actual CER and is not an OCR/ASR benchmark

metrics.primary: DeltaDrop = (word clean macro-F1 - mean word macro-F1 at 0.05 across 3 noise seeds) - (char clean macro-F1 - mean char macro-F1 at 0.05 across 3 noise seeds); positive means char lost less F1
report: primary pair plus majority at each nonzero rate/seed

bootstrap.scheme: stratified resampling of 40 test poems within each author with replacement; same indices across paired models/conditions/noise seeds
bootstrap.limits: conditional on this fixed split and models; not training-seed or unseen-author uncertainty; no p-values or universal superiority claim

execution.preliminary_gate: time and memory benchmark only on development/audit material, no final test performance; do not treat it as an independent result
execution.warnings: preserve non-convergence; no silent iteration increase or model dropping
execution.failure: stop, keep artifacts and log reason; revise/version before test if needed

gates_before_test: rights/provenance scope recorded without raw redistribution
duplicate graph and development exclusion verified
all 9 clean validation readouts and primary noisy validation readouts saved
separate final evaluation plan plus exclusive per-output start marker
future_scope: indexed retrieval and real OCR/ASR require separate protocols; no implementation, acquisition, training or test evaluation authorized by writing this file
